owner_priority: No assumption is rendered/shared as confirmed readiness
catalog_status: Bounded handoff catalog.json:68 verified identity/eligibility rows,18 disabled entries; full roster40; exhaustive=false. Extra exclusions in candidates-disabled.json.

entry_shape.name: static display label
entry_shape.knownSpellIDs: exact learned/override identities accepted; no name-based aliasing
entry_shape.verified: ID and class/spec eligibility verified, not readiness
entry_shape.eligibility: additional verified conditions or explicit unknown
entry_shape.requiredTalentSpellIDs: ALL additional modifiers must be positively selected/known; do not treat as alternative activation aliases.

classification.major: Primary large survival button: immunity, large/broad mitigation, major health buffer or emergency survival heal; not inferred from duration alone.
classification.minor: Smaller/shorter, evasive/conditional protection or active mitigation; passive effects and pure movement/offense excluded.
classification.exceptions: Class/spec context and emergency healing classification are product choices, recorded per entry; not native facts or availability.

runtime_gates: Only verified identity rows may become tracked; current public class/spec must be in the row and exact current learned/override ID must be readable and known.
Unverified candidate disabled, excluded spec coverage Unknown. Never infer not known from secret/nil/error.
No row or classification implies available, carried, talented, unused or ready.
Spell identity changes on spec/talent/override changes invalidate cached observations.
Cap32 unique tracked spell identities per current spec; catalog membership is not a per-frame scan request.

Honor every row prerequisite. Fortifying Brew115203 additionally requires talent388917/resolved mapping; Fade586 requires373446; Earth Elemental198103 requires1279819. Unknown gate excludes confirmed availability.

observation_shape.context: pull-baseline | cooldown-event | charge-event | interval | death-notification | bags-event
observation_shape.reason: explicit reason, including secret/missing/API failure/not observed/gap

rules: Current post-death/out-of-combat state is distinct from frozen last-alive and death-notification observations.
GetSpellCooldown isActive/isEnabled are public fields; numeric timings may be secret. isOnGCD is trusted only in SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN context.
Charge recharging does not imply zero charges; use public actual current count or Unknown.
isEnabled=false is held cooldown, not proof of ready.
Observed cast and readiness are independent. Cast may leave charges or reset; missing cast is not unused.
Actual cached bag data supports carried/absent only with complete readable coverage; stack count is not Healthstone charges.
IsUsableItem/IsSpellUsable at death is measured while dead; do not use as pre-hit eligibility proof.
No missing/secret/error => zero, false, none, unavailable or available. No secret arithmetic, sorting, concatenation for export or serialization.
Frozen observations and source clocks are never silently updated after death.
Saturated confirmed state requires its narrowly defined supported observation; Unknown distinct; dim keeps actual reason. Never label full pre-fatal usability as proven.
